integrity_note: The computations are exact finite checks, while the all-size claim follows from a structural cellular and representation-theoretic argument. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Integral homotopy type of the quotient, equivariant homotopy splitting, and all other word truncations are unproved; only a rational cohomology-ring comparison is established for the quotient.
title: A persistent rational five-sphere cohomology class in symmetric quotients of two-letter injective-word moment-angle spaces
